metadata.title: Clicked like I was swiping a menu and scared 1 confused soul? Valorant logic is illegal
metadata.description:
Tapping like I was ordering food
That 1 poor enemy definitely questioning their life
Did NOT deserve that surprise zap but hey, free chaos
Tap if your aim’s mostly ‘oops, somehow worked’ too!

Tap if your aim’s more accident than skill!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
